column1: # Reviewed semantic identities for the GAME CD/TIM/map-resource loading family.
# Every row was checked with kf sema addr/disasm --blocks/xref/xref --callees/strings/match, decoded callers,
# adjacent boundaries, Ghidra candidates, source/history state, raw object disassembly, and FID/vendor controls.
# Shared paths, archives, direct call chains, one compiler profile, contiguous code, and one contiguous literal pool support the consolidated resources TU.

column6: framed retry loop prefixes the supplied relative path with \\KF\\, appends ;1, locates the file, rounds its length to 2048 bytes, allocates storage, writes the output slot, and drives CdControl/CdRead/CdReadSync until completion
column7: four callers pass a stack address for the result and a read-only relative path; the returned allocation feeds TIM, common-resource, and weapon loaders
column8: first a0 is only written through as a pointer-sized result slot; a1 is consumed by strcat; callers treat v0 as a signed zero/nonzero status
column9: absent from functions_vendored.tsv and the FID census; identified libc/CD services are callees while allocation, retry, and output-slot policy are game-owned
column12: supported behavior and signature with exact C reconstruction

column7: eleven callers supply stack, asset, screen, save-icon, weapon, or audio destinations plus read-only relative paths; several test the returned status
column8: full-width a0 is forwarded as the destination address, a1 is consumed as a string, and callers use v0 as a signed zero/nonzero result
column9: absent from functions_vendored.tsv and the FID census; identified libc/CD services are callees while destination and retry policy are game-owned
column12: supported behavior and signature with exact C reconstruction

column6: seven-block loop calls OpenTIM once, repeatedly fills one 0x14-byte TIM_IMAGE with ReadTIM, and conditionally uploads the CLUT then pixel image with a DrawSync after each LoadImage
column7: eight callers pass loaded TIM buffers; all four service identities and the TIM_IMAGE field order are from Psy-Q Release 2.5 LIBGPU.H
column8: a0 is forwarded unchanged to OpenTIM as u_long pointer; no result escapes
column9: absent from functions_vendored.tsv and the FID census; OpenTIM, ReadTIM, LoadImage, and DrawSync are separately proved vendored callees, not bodies reconstructed as game progress
column12: supported SDK-boundary type and exact C reconstruction

column7: sole caller is game_main_loop; invokes the TIM, CD, weapon-record, asset-aux, actor-definition, and map-object-definition loaders and copies a 4-byte chunk header plus 0xcc0 bytes of render_cell_windows and forty 0x0c growth records
column8: no argument register is live at entry and no result escapes
column9: absent from functions_vendored.tsv and the FID census; linked Sony/libc routines are identified callees while archive layout and subsystem distribution are game-owned
column12: supported startup/resource identity with exact C reconstruction in the consolidated resources TU

column6: straight-line leaf adds ASCII zero to its argument, stores the low byte at map_resource_path+1, and returns with a nop delay slot
column7: sole caller passes the current floor before loading MIX.TIM, MIXA.DAT, and MIXB.DAT; initial path bytes are B0\\
column8: the caller loads an u8 field, O32 promotes it, and the exact callee consumes the full s32 argument before its byte store
column9: absent from functions_vendored.tsv and the FID census; mutable game path selection has no libc or SDK body analogue
column12: supported path-byte action and exact C reconstruction

column6: framed wrapper copies the supplied filename to map_resource_path+3, calls the allocated CD loader with a stack output slot, and returns that pointer
column7: three calls from map_resources_load supply MIX.TIM, MIXA.DAT, and MIXB.DAT; the shared 12-byte path preserves B0\\ plus a nine-byte filename including NUL
column8: a0 is consumed as const string input and v0 returns the pointer written to the stack slot
column9: absent from functions_vendored.tsv and the FID census; strcpy is an identified vendored callee while map path/allocation composition is game-owned
column12: supported filename and pointer-return contract with exact C reconstruction

column7: five chained calls copy 0x9c4 words each into the attribute-height, floor-height, orientation, collision-flag, and collision grids; there are no other callers
